## What may be documented

The RBAC catalog is the union of shipped and intended features. Its own
header says submodules without a route are *"aspirational features the UI
doesn't render yet"*. Documenting those would describe screens nobody can
open, so only **SHIPPED** entries describe things a user can do today.

| Status | Count | May be documented as existing? |
|---|---|---|
| SHIPPED | 193 | **Yes** |
| LEGACY_ONLY | 0 | Only if the behaviour is reachable |
| ROUTE_CLAIMED_NOT_MOUNTED | 0 | **No** — route declared but not mounted |
| ASPIRATIONAL | 11 | **No** — permission-only |
| **Total submodules** | **204** | |
